newsitem.title: POLAND: Kable leaps on good February earnings.
newsitem.headline: Kable leaps on good February earnings.

text.p: Polish cable maker Kable SA jumped the session's record 7.1 percent to 39.1 zlotys in a moderate turnover on good February earnings, traders said.
"Kable showed very good profits so no wonder it grows and I wouldn't be surprised if it extended gains in the next few sessions," one trader said.
On Monday Kable reported February net profit of 0.6 million zlotys on 12 million-zloty sales, well above the 1996 February net of 130,000 zlotys.
Some traders said Kable trading at 12.5 times 1997 prospective earnings looked attactive compared with the whole market's 1997 P/E of 14.
